```{r}
median_centering <- function(df) {
  df_norm <- as.data.frame(apply(df, 2, function(x) {
                        gMedian = median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
                        x - gMedian
  }
    ))
  return(df_norm)
}
```

# Methods
```{r}
rf_fun <- function(df_raw) {
  res_all <- missForest(as.data.frame(df_raw), verbose = FALSE)
  res_all$ximp
}

minprob_fun <- function(df_raw) {
  impute.MinProb(df_raw, q = 0.01, tune.sigma = 1)
}

soft_hybrid_impute <- function(df_rf, df_minProb, df_raw, 
                               r0 = NULL, x0 = NULL, a = 10, b = 5, lambda = 0.5,
                               visualize = TRUE, group_name = NULL,
                               save_dir = "./SoftHybrid_DIA") {
  stopifnot(all(dim(df_rf) == dim(df_minProb)))
  stopifnot(all(rownames(df_rf) == rownames(df_minProb)))

  missing_rate <- rowMeans(is.na(df_raw))
  mean_intensity <- rowMeans(df_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  miss_cor <- data.frame(
    missing_rate = missing_rate,
    mean_abundance = mean_intensity
  )

  q3 <- quantile(miss_cor$missing_rate, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  skip_loess <- q3 == 0

  if (skip_loess) {
    elbow_x <- 1 / ncol(df_raw)
    candidates <- mean_intensity[round(missing_rate, 6) == round(elbow_x, 6)]
    if (length(candidates) == 0) {
      elbow_y <- mean(mean_intensity, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      elbow_y <- mean(candidates, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  } else {
    loess_fit <- loess(mean_abundance ~ missing_rate, data = miss_cor, span = 0.75)
    x_vals <- seq(min(miss_cor$missing_rate), max(miss_cor$missing_rate), length.out = 1000)
    y_vals <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = data.frame(missing_rate = x_vals))

    x_start <- x_vals[1]; y_start <- y_vals[1]
    x_end   <- x_vals[length(x_vals)]; y_end <- y_vals[length(y_vals)]
    line_vec <- c(x_end - x_start, y_end - y_start)

    distances <- sapply(seq_along(x_vals), function(i) {
      point_vec <- c(x_vals[i] - x_start, y_vals[i] - y_start)
      cross_prod <- abs(line_vec[1] * point_vec[2] - line_vec[2] * point_vec[1])
      norm_line <- sqrt(sum(line_vec^2))
      cross_prod / norm_line
    })

    max_index <- which.max(distances)
    elbow_x <- x_vals[max_index]
    elbow_y <- y_vals[max_index]
  }

  r0 <- elbow_x
  x0 <- elbow_y

  sigmoid <- function(x, k, x0) 1 / (1 + exp(-k * (x - x0)))

  sigmoid_r <- sigmoid(missing_rate, k = a, x0 = r0)
  sigmoid_x <- sigmoid(mean_intensity, k = b, x0 = x0)

  p_MNAR <- sigmoid_r * (1 - lambda * sigmoid_x)
  weight_rf <- 1 - p_MNAR

  df_imp_soft <- df_rf
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_rf))) {
    w <- weight_rf[i]
    df_imp_soft[i, ] <- w * df_rf[i, ] + (1 - w) * df_minProb[i, ]
  }

  if (visualize) {
    library(ggplot2)
    library(scales)
    library(dplyr)

    df_plot <- data.frame(
      Protein = rownames(df_rf),
      MissingRate = missing_rate,
      MeanIntensity = mean_intensity,
      Weight_RF = weight_rf
    )

    eps <- 0.02
    df_mid_line <- df_plot %>%
      filter(!is.na(Weight_RF)) %>%
      mutate(diff = abs(Weight_RF - 0.5)) %>%
      filter(diff < eps) %>%
      group_by(MissingRate) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = diff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(MissingRate)

    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = MissingRate, y = MeanIntensity, color = Weight_RF)) +
      geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
      {
        if (nrow(df_mid_line) >= 2)
          geom_line(
            data = df_mid_line,
            aes(x = MissingRate, y = MeanIntensity),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = "black",
            linewidth = 1,
            linetype = "dashed"
          )
      } +
      {
        if (nrow(df_mid_line) >= 1)
          geom_point(
            data = df_mid_line,
            aes(x = MissingRate, y = MeanIntensity),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            shape = 21,
            fill = "white",
            color = "black",
            size = 2.5,
            stroke = 0.8
          )
      } +
      scale_color_gradient2(
        low = "#2166AC",    
        mid = "#FFD700",    
        high = "#B2182B",  
        midpoint = 0.5,
        limits = c(0, 1),
        oob = scales::squish
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
        labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Soft Hybrid Weights (", group_name, ")"),
        x = "Missing Rate",
        y = "Mean Intensity",
        color = "RF Weight"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    text             = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(color = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"), 
    axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"), 
    axis.ticks.length= unit(2, "mm"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15), 
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold") 
  )

    print(p)

    if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(save_dir, paste0(group_name, "_SoftHybrid_plot.tiff")),
      plot = p,
      device = "tiff",
      dpi = 300,
      width = 6,
      height = 3.5,
      units = "in"
    )
  }

  return(df_imp_soft)
}
```

# Masking: MAR + lowMNAR
```{r}
addMiss_for_tuning <- function(x,
                               MV.rate = 0.3,
                               MNAR.ratio = 0.5,
                               ini.seed = 233,
                               thr_sd = 0.3) {
  stopifnot(MV.rate >= 0, MV.rate <= 1, MNAR.ratio >= 0, MNAR.ratio <= 1)

  set.seed(ini.seed)

  x_mat <- as.matrix(x)
  nr <- nrow(x_mat); nc <- ncol(x_mat)

  obs_idx <- which(!is.na(x_mat))
  N_obs <- length(obs_idx)
  if (N_obs == 0) stop("No observed values in x.")

  target_total <- floor(N_obs * MV.rate)
  target_mnar  <- floor(target_total * MNAR.ratio)
  target_mar   <- target_total - target_mnar

  if (target_total == 0) {
    return(list(x_masked = x_mat, mask_idx = integer(0), truth = numeric(0),
                target_total = 0, target_mnar = 0, target_mar = 0))
  }

  t_q <- as.numeric(quantile(x_mat[obs_idx], probs = MV.rate, na.rm = TRUE))

  t_mat  <- matrix(rnorm(nr * nc, mean = t_q, sd = thr_sd), nrow = nr, ncol = nc)
  t_draw <- matrix(rbinom(nr * nc, size = 1, prob = MNAR.ratio), nrow = nr, ncol = nc)

  cand_mnar <- which(!is.na(x_mat) & (x_mat < t_mat) & (t_draw == 1))

  if (length(cand_mnar) >= target_mnar) {
    mnar_idx <- sample(cand_mnar, target_mnar)
  } else {
    mnar_idx <- cand_mnar
  }

  remaining_obs <- setdiff(obs_idx, mnar_idx)

  if (length(remaining_obs) < target_mar) {
    mar_idx <- remaining_obs
  } else {
    mar_idx <- sample(remaining_obs, target_mar)
  }

  mask_idx <- c(mnar_idx, mar_idx)
  truth <- x_mat[mask_idx]

  x_masked <- x_mat
  x_masked[mask_idx] <- NA

  list(
    x_masked = x_masked,
    mask_idx = mask_idx,
    truth = truth,
    target_total = length(mask_idx),
    target_mnar = length(mnar_idx),
    target_mar = length(mar_idx)
  )
}
```
# Class A protein: typeMNAR
```{r}
define_classA_and_typeMNAR <- function(mat, sample_type,
                                       det_hi = 0.75,
                                       miss_hi = 0.75) {
  stopifnot(length(sample_type) == ncol(mat))
  types <- unique(sample_type)
  nr <- nrow(mat)

  det_rate <- sapply(types, function(tt) {
    cols <- which(sample_type == tt)
    rowMeans(!is.na(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE]))
  })
  rownames(det_rate) <- rownames(mat)

  classA_prots <- character(0)
  typeMNAR_idx <- integer(0)

  for (p in rownames(mat)) {
    Td <- types[det_rate[p, ] >= det_hi]
    Tm <- types[(1 - det_rate[p, ]) >= miss_hi]

    if (length(Td) < 1 || length(Tm) < 1) next
    if (length(setdiff(Tm, Td)) == 0) next  

    classA_prots <- c(classA_prots, p)

    r <- match(p, rownames(mat))
    for (tt in Tm) {
      cols <- which(sample_type == tt)
      na_cols <- cols[is.na(mat[r, cols, drop = TRUE])]
      if (length(na_cols) == 0) next
      idx <- (na_cols - 1) * nr + r
      typeMNAR_idx <- c(typeMNAR_idx, idx)
    }
  }

  list(
    classA_proteins = unique(classA_prots),
    typeMNAR_idx = unique(typeMNAR_idx),
    det_rate = det_rate
  )
}

make_per_sample_floor <- function(mat, q = 0.01) {
  apply(mat, 2, function(v) quantile(v, probs = q, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
}
```

# Cache generation
```{r}
dir_create <- function(path) if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE)

prep_cache_one <- function(X_complete,
                           MV_rate,
                           beta = 0.5,
                           rep_id,
                           seed,
                           cache_dir,
                           addMiss_fun,
                           rf_fun,
                           minprob_fun,
                           sample_type,
                           det_hi = 0.75,
                           miss_hi = 0.75,
                           floor_q = 0.01,
                           overwrite = FALSE) {

  subdir <- file.path(cache_dir,
                      paste0("MV", MV_rate, "_beta", beta),
                      sprintf("rep%02d", rep_id))
  dir_create(subdir)

  f_raw   <- file.path(subdir, "raw.rds")
  f_rf    <- file.path(subdir, "rf.rds")
  f_minp  <- file.path(subdir, "minProb.rds")
  f_mask  <- file.path(subdir, "mask_idx.rds")
  f_truth <- file.path(subdir, "truth.rds")

  ## NEW files
  f_type  <- file.path(subdir, "typeMNAR_idx.rds")
  f_floor <- file.path(subdir, "floor_col.rds")

  if (!overwrite &&
      file.exists(f_rf) && file.exists(f_minp) &&
      file.exists(f_mask) && file.exists(f_truth) &&
      file.exists(f_type) && file.exists(f_floor)) {
    return(invisible(subdir))
  }

  # ---- (A) compute typeMNAR on ORIGINAL complete matrix ----
  cls <- define_classA_and_typeMNAR(X_complete, sample_type, det_hi = det_hi, miss_hi = miss_hi)
  typeMNAR_idx_full <- cls$typeMNAR_idx

  # per-sample floor on complete matrix (same scale as X_complete)
  floor_col <- make_per_sample_floor(X_complete, q = floor_q)

  # ---- (B) masking on complete matrix ----
  masked <- addMiss_fun(X_complete, MV.rate = MV_rate, MNAR.ratio = beta, ini.seed = seed)
  x_masked <- as.matrix(masked$x_masked)
  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(x_masked)))

  # ---- (C) convert mask_idx to rc ----
  rc0 <- arrayInd(masked$mask_idx, .dim = dim(x_masked))
  truth0 <- masked$truth

  # ---- (D) filter proteins on MASKED matrix (keep missing_rate < 0.9) ----
  miss_rate <- rowSums(is.na(x_masked)) / ncol(x_masked)
  keep_rows <- which(miss_rate < 0.9)

  x_filt <- x_masked[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  # ---- (E) remap mask_idx into filtered space ----
  ok_mask <- rc0[, 1] %in% keep_rows
  rc_keep <- rc0[ok_mask, , drop = FALSE]
  truth <- truth0[ok_mask]

  row_map <- match(rc_keep[, 1], keep_rows)
  col_idx <- rc_keep[, 2]
  mask_idx <- (col_idx - 1) * nrow(x_filt) + row_map

  # ---- (F) remap typeMNAR_idx into filtered space ----
  if (length(typeMNAR_idx_full) > 0) {
    rc_type <- arrayInd(typeMNAR_idx_full, .dim = dim(X_complete))  # (row,col) in full space
    ok_type <- rc_type[, 1] %in% keep_rows
    rc_type_keep <- rc_type[ok_type, , drop = FALSE]
    row_map_type <- match(rc_type_keep[, 1], keep_rows)
    col_type <- rc_type_keep[, 2]
    typeMNAR_idx <- (col_type - 1) * nrow(x_filt) + row_map_type
    typeMNAR_idx <- unique(typeMNAR_idx)
  } else {
    typeMNAR_idx <- integer(0)
  }

  # ---- (G) run imputations on filtered matrix ----
  df_raw <- as.data.frame(x_filt)
  df_rf <- rf_fun(df_raw)
  df_minProb <- minprob_fun(df_raw)

  # ---- (H) save cached objects ----
  saveRDS(df_raw,     f_raw)
  saveRDS(df_rf,      f_rf)
  saveRDS(df_minProb, f_minp)
  saveRDS(mask_idx,   f_mask)
  saveRDS(truth,      f_truth)

  saveRDS(typeMNAR_idx, f_type)
  saveRDS(floor_col,    f_floor)

  invisible(subdir)
}

prep_cache_all <- function(X_complete,
                           MV_rates = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8),
                           beta = 0.5,
                           repeats = 5,
                           base_seed = 1001,
                           cache_dir = "./tuning_cache_50cell",
                           addMiss_fun,
                           rf_fun,
                           minprob_fun,
                           sample_type,
                           det_hi = 0.75,
                           miss_hi = 0.75,
                           floor_q = 0.01,
                           overwrite = FALSE) {

  dir_create(cache_dir)

  total_jobs <- length(MV_rates) * repeats
  job <- 0

  for (mv in MV_rates) {
    for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {
      job <- job + 1
      seed <- base_seed + as.integer(mv*1000) * 100 + r

      subdir <- file.path(cache_dir,
                          paste0("MV", mv, "_beta", beta),
                          sprintf("rep%02d", r))

      msg0 <- sprintf("[CACHE %d/%d] MV=%.1f beta=%.2f rep=%02d -> %s",
                      job, total_jobs, mv, beta, r, subdir)
      message(msg0)
      flush.console()

      t0 <- Sys.time()
      prep_cache_one(
        X_complete = X_complete,
        MV_rate = mv,
        beta = beta,
        rep_id = r,
        seed = seed,
        cache_dir = cache_dir,
        addMiss_fun = addMiss_fun,
        rf_fun = rf_fun,
        minprob_fun = minprob_fun,
        sample_type = sample_type,
        det_hi = det_hi,
        miss_hi = miss_hi,
        floor_q = floor_q,
        overwrite = overwrite
      )
      dt <- difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")
      message(sprintf("  done in %.1f sec", as.numeric(dt)))
      flush.console()
    }
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
} 
```

# Union RMSE scorer (mask truth + typeMNAR floor truth)
```{r}
rmse_union_mask_and_typeMNAR <- function(df_imp, mask_idx, truth_mask,
                                        typeMNAR_idx, floor_col, nrow_mat) {
  # df_imp: imputed matrix (same dim as cached df_raw)
  # mask truth is provided as truth_mask (vector aligned to mask_idx)
  # typeMNAR truth: floor_col per sample
  # nrow_mat: number of proteins in filtered matrix

  imp_mat <- as.matrix(df_imp)
  nc <- ncol(imp_mat)

  # union index set
  U <- union(mask_idx, typeMNAR_idx)

  # predicted
  pred <- imp_mat[U]

  # truth init as NA
  truth <- rep(NA_real_, length(U))

  # (A) fill truth for mask_idx from truth_mask
  pos_mask <- match(mask_idx, U)  # positions in U
  truth[pos_mask] <- truth_mask

  # (B) fill truth for typeMNAR_idx from per-sample floor
  if (length(typeMNAR_idx) > 0) {
    pos_type <- match(typeMNAR_idx, U)
    rc_type <- arrayInd(typeMNAR_idx, .dim = c(nrow_mat, nc))
    truth[pos_type] <- floor_col[rc_type[, 2]]
  }

  ok <- !is.na(truth) & !is.na(pred)
  sqrt(mean((pred[ok] - truth[ok])^2))
}

rmse_mask_classA_macro <- function(df_imp,
                                   mask_idx, truth_mask,
                                   typeMNAR_idx, floor_col,
                                   nrow_mat) {
  imp_mat <- as.matrix(df_imp)
  nc <- ncol(imp_mat)

  ## ---- (A) Mask RMSE ----
  rmse_mask <- NA_real_
  if (length(mask_idx) > 0) {
    pred_m <- imp_mat[mask_idx]
    ok_m <- !is.na(pred_m) & !is.na(truth_mask)
    if (sum(ok_m) > 0) {
      rmse_mask <- sqrt(mean((pred_m[ok_m] - truth_mask[ok_m])^2))
    }
  }

  ## ---- (B) ClassA/typeMNAR RMSE ----
  rmse_classA <- NA_real_
  if (length(typeMNAR_idx) > 0) {
    pred_a <- imp_mat[typeMNAR_idx]

    # map linear indices -> (row,col) so we can pick per-sample floor
    rc_a <- arrayInd(typeMNAR_idx, .dim = c(nrow_mat, nc))
    truth_a <- floor_col[rc_a[, 2]]

    ok_a <- !is.na(pred_a) & !is.na(truth_a)
    if (sum(ok_a) > 0) {
      rmse_classA <- sqrt(mean((pred_a[ok_a] - truth_a[ok_a])^2))
    }
  }

  ## ---- (C) Macro (equal weight across subsets) ----
  rmse_macro <- mean(c(rmse_mask, rmse_classA), na.rm = TRUE)

  list(
    rmse_macro  = rmse_macro,
    rmse_mask   = rmse_mask,
    rmse_classA = rmse_classA
  )
}
```

# Evaluation
```{r}
score_theta <- function(a, b, lambda,
                        MV_rates = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8),
                        beta = 0.5,
                        repeats = 5,
                        cache_dir = "./tuning_cache_50cell",
                        visualize = TRUE,
                        save_dir = "./SoftHybrid_tuning_plots_new_rerun") {

  dir_create(save_dir)

  per_mv <- data.frame(
    MV_rate = MV_rates,
    mean_macro  = NA_real_, sd_macro  = NA_real_,
    mean_mask   = NA_real_, sd_mask   = NA_real_,
    mean_classA = NA_real_, sd_classA = NA_real_
  )

  all_rmse_macro  <- c()
  all_rmse_mask   <- c()
  all_rmse_classA <- c()

  for (ii in seq_along(MV_rates)) {
    mv <- MV_rates[ii]

    rmses_macro  <- c()
    rmses_mask   <- c()
    rmses_classA <- c()

    for (r in seq_len(repeats)) {

      subdir <- file.path(
        cache_dir,
        paste0("MV", mv, "_beta", beta),
        sprintf("rep%02d", r)
      )

      df_raw   <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "raw.rds"))
      df_rf    <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "rf.rds"))
      df_minp  <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "minProb.rds"))
      mask_idx <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "mask_idx.rds"))
      truth    <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "truth.rds"))

      ## NEW: ClassA/typeMNAR evaluation
      typeMNAR_idx <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "typeMNAR_idx.rds"))
      floor_col    <- readRDS(file.path(subdir, "floor_col.rds"))

      df_imp <- soft_hybrid_impute(
        df_rf = df_rf,
        df_minProb = df_minp,
        df_raw = df_raw,
        r0 = NULL, x0 = NULL,
        a = a, b = b, lambda = lambda,
        visualize = visualize,
        group_name = paste0("MV=", mv, "_rep=", r, "_a=", a, "_b=", b, "_lambada=", lambda),
        save_dir = save_dir
      )

      rmse_out <- rmse_mask_classA_macro(
        df_imp       = df_imp,
        mask_idx     = mask_idx,
        truth_mask   = truth,
        typeMNAR_idx = typeMNAR_idx,
        floor_col    = floor_col,
        nrow_mat     = nrow(df_raw)
      )

      rmses_macro  <- c(rmses_macro,  rmse_out$rmse_macro)
      rmses_mask   <- c(rmses_mask,   rmse_out$rmse_mask)
      rmses_classA <- c(rmses_classA, rmse_out$rmse_classA)
    }

    per_mv$mean_macro[ii]  <- mean(rmses_macro,  na.rm = TRUE)
    per_mv$sd_macro[ii]    <- sd(rmses_macro,    na.rm = TRUE)

    per_mv$mean_mask[ii]   <- mean(rmses_mask,   na.rm = TRUE)
    per_mv$sd_mask[ii]     <- sd(rmses_mask,     na.rm = TRUE)

    per_mv$mean_classA[ii] <- mean(rmses_classA, na.rm = TRUE)
    per_mv$sd_classA[ii]   <- sd(rmses_classA,   na.rm = TRUE)

    all_rmse_macro  <- c(all_rmse_macro,  rmses_macro)
    all_rmse_mask   <- c(all_rmse_mask,   rmses_mask)
    all_rmse_classA <- c(all_rmse_classA, rmses_classA)
  }

  overall_mean_macro  <- mean(per_mv$mean_macro,  na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_sd_macro    <- sd(all_rmse_macro,       na.rm = TRUE)

  overall_mean_mask   <- mean(per_mv$mean_mask,   na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_sd_mask     <- sd(all_rmse_mask,        na.rm = TRUE)

  overall_mean_classA <- mean(per_mv$mean_classA, na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_sd_classA   <- sd(all_rmse_classA,      na.rm = TRUE)

  list(
    a = a, b = b, lambda = lambda,
    overall_mean_macro  = overall_mean_macro,
    overall_sd_macro    = overall_sd_macro,
    overall_mean_mask   = overall_mean_mask,
    overall_sd_mask     = overall_sd_mask,
    overall_mean_classA = overall_mean_classA,
    overall_sd_classA   = overall_sd_classA,
    per_mv = per_mv
  )
}
```

# Grid Searcher Helpers
```{r}
coarse_grid <- expand.grid(
  a = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
  b = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
  lambda = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)
)

run_grid <- function(grid_df, ...) {
  res_list <- vector("list", nrow(grid_df))
  out_tbl <- data.frame()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid_df))) {
    z <- score_theta(
      a = grid_df$a[i],
      b = grid_df$b[i],
      lambda = grid_df$lambda[i],
      ...
    )
    res_list[[i]] <- z

    out_tbl <- rbind(out_tbl, data.frame(
      a = z$a, b = z$b, lambda = z$lambda,
      overall_mean_macro  = z$overall_mean_macro,
      overall_sd_macro    = z$overall_sd_macro,
      overall_mean_mask   = z$overall_mean_mask,
      overall_mean_classA = z$overall_mean_classA
    ))

    mv_line <- paste0(
      sprintf("MV%.1f M=%.3f (mask=%.3f, A=%.3f)",
              z$per_mv$MV_rate, z$per_mv$mean_macro, z$per_mv$mean_mask, z$per_mv$mean_classA),
      collapse = " | "
    )

    message(sprintf(
      "Done %d/%d | a=%g b=%g lam=%.2f | overall(M)=%.4f | mask=%.4f | A=%.4f | %s",
      i, nrow(grid_df), z$a, z$b, z$lambda,
      z$overall_mean_macro, z$overall_mean_mask, z$overall_mean_classA,
      mv_line
    ))
  }

  out_tbl <- out_tbl[order(out_tbl$overall_mean_macro), ]
  list(summary = out_tbl, details = res_list)
}
```

```{r , warning =FALSE}

)
```
